The "[[Figrin D'an]] Killer"...This card is one of the best counters to the Rebel's sure fire Force Regeneration Strategy using [[Figrin D'an]]. Played in combination with [[U-3PO (Yoo-Threepio){{!}}U-3PO]], and you can move an infected droid wherever the Rebels try to run. Since no Rebel would dare leave [[Figrin D'an]] alone at a site, your sure to Trap multiple Rebel characters in the explosion. Should they dare use Figrin D'ans Force Regeneration ability, they risk five destiny draws, each with the potential of setting off the explosion. A simple two card combo that is extremely effective.
